Subject: Re: Intro / Demo — aligning on times and procurement checkpoint

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. We're excited to see Redwood running against a few of our representative workloads. Two constraints on our side:

- Procurement wants a short walkthrough of licensing/seat model and invoicing timeline before we lock a pilot PO.
- Our security engineer (Tom) needs a quick pre-demo review of data handling (KV cache, logs, retention) — 15 minutes is fine.

We are distributed across APAC and EMEA — ideal overlap windows for our teams are:
- Tue 2028-04-11 08:00–10:00 SGT / 01:00–03:00 BST (tight)
- Wed 2028-04-11 19:00–21:00 SGT / 12:00–14:00 BST / 07:00–09:00 EDT (best for engineering + procurement)
- Thu 2028-04-12 06:00–08:00 SGT (short slot for security only)

Can you propose a relay-style schedule so our regional engineers can rotate into the demo without forcing anyone to take a middle-of-night call? Ideally: 30–40 minute demo + 15 minutes procurement Q&A + 15 minutes security hit-list.

I've attached our procurement checklist to this email.

—Sarah
Sr. Product Ops, Nebula Systems
attachments: procurement_checklist.pdf (PDF, 320 KB)
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

Hi Sarah — great context, thanks.

Short answer: yes, we can run a relay/demo-handshake format that hits engineering highlights, then hands to procurement, then finishes with a security micro-review. Proposed approach:

1) 30 min product demo (AE + SE): key workflows, latency/cost tradeoffs, routing/fallback behavior.
2) 15 min procurement walkthrough (pricing bands, reserved vs hosted, billing cadence).
3) 15 min security micro-review (logs, retention, KMS integration bullets + next steps for a deeper follow-up).

Proposed windows (we'll put SEs in rotating shifts so someone is fresh for each chunk):
- Wed 2028-04-11 19:00–20:00 SGT / 12:00–13:00 BST / 07:00–08:00 EDT — full relay (preferred).
- Wed 2028-04-11 20:00–21:00 SGT — alternate if your procurement needs a slightly later APAC slot.
- Thu 2028-04-12 06:00–06:45 SGT — security-only micro-review.

Marissa: can you confirm SE availability for the 19:00 SGT slot? Neha / Marcus: can you join procurement + security portions respectively? I can run the demo and handle pricing.

I attached our demo slide deck and a short security FAQ we typically share.

Thanks — Vivek
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
